# Welcome to Baseball

This site explores Major League Baseball history through the Lahman database. Comparing home runs per team-game, rather than raw season totals, puts shortened seasons in context: seasons that looked like dramatic slumps become much more ordinary when we account for how many games teams played.

The site also ranks the career home-run leaders and takes a closer look at Barry Bonds’s season-by-season totals. Visit the **Home runs** and **Sluggers** pages in the navbar to explore the analysis.
